source.title: Unfamiliar Foulness
source.description:
<You have found a vial of foul, viscous liquid on a laboratory table. It was surrounded by various ingredients that have been meticulously measured and diced into careful portions. Though the herbs are unidentifiable, one undamaged and discolored beast heart rested nearby.

Alchemists in Darnassus might have an idea of how to tap into whatever restorative properties might be present in the potion. You should also bring them some flowers, as to not come barreling into a shop with just a pile of hearts.>
source.objective: Gather Discolored Beast Hearts and Bleeding Hearts from the plaguelands. Bring them and the Mishandled Healing Potion to an interested alchemist in Darnassus.
source.progress: Ishnu-alah, traveler. Have you come to practice the art of alchemy or is there something else I can assist you with?
source.completion:
I almost suspected such, could you believe that you are not the first to show me this exact revelation? Were the implications not so dire, I would assume this is an elaborate practical joke at my expense.

Studying the effects of the plaguelands, while often fascinating, is not practical due to its distance from home. Nonetheless I have made progress with previous samples provided to me, and would like to share my findings with you.

Please keep me in mind if you find more specimens.
